An economics graduate born to Sardinian parents, he chaired the management of Ventunoinvestimenti, a Lugano consultancy. He maintained family ties with Sardinia, regularly returning to the island for summer holidays.

long_biography.plain_text:
Swiss businessman Luigi Mameli consolidated his ownership of Ventunoinvestimenti in two stages. His stake rose from one third to two thirds in 2021, before he became sole shareholder the following year. Francesco Frigerio remained a manager after giving up his shares. The firm's remit covered technical and marketing advice, sales and commercial intermediation.

Mameli also held appointments outside Switzerland. In Lanzarote, he became sole administrator of RDG Islas, formerly Belduca Lanzarote. He was recorded as an owner and authorised representative of Real Mita in Tivat, Montenegro, alongside a separately appointed executive director.
